newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 2-year notes high yield 6.027 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 2-year notes high yield 6.027 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said its Dutch auction of $15.506 billion of 2-year notes produced a high yield of 6.027 percent and said it awarded 90 percent of bids at the high.
The interest rate on the bills will be 6 percent.
The median yield was 6.010 percent and the low yield was 5.950 percent.
A total of $38.186 billion in bids were received, including $1.15 billion in noncompetitive bids from the public.
The bills will be issued on June 30 and mature on June 30, 1999.
The high yield was down from 6.328 pct at the last auction of 2-year notes on May 28 and was the lowest since 5.885 percent on Feb 25.
